[[File:Charon_bioscientist.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A Charon bioscientist]]
A '''bioscientist''' was a specialized form of [[Charon/Legends|Charon]]. All were [[Gender/Legends|female]], and they were smaller than the [[Warrior (Charon)|warriors]]. They had iridescent [[cilia]] on their forelegs and were more agile than the warriors, but slower. They used their extensive knowledge to create [[Bioengineering/Legends|bio-constructs]] lacking individual free will. They were passionate about their work, and were able to grasp concepts such as long term goals and planning.
